description: This Python source file contains utility functions and classes related to image processing, template matching, feature detection, and detection result management within a branding compliance analysis system. It defines a Detection dataclass, functions for image conversion, preprocessing, multi-scale template matching, feature matching fallback, and visualization.

classes.name: Detection
classes.description: Represents a detected object in the image with position, size, score, and template identification.

methods.description: Converts a PIL Image object to an OpenCV BGR numpy array, handling alpha transparency.

methods.description: Encodes a BGR OpenCV image into PNG format bytes.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] clamp_rect(x: int, y: int, w: int, h: int, W: int, H: int)
methods.description: Ensures a rectangle specified by position and size stays within image boundaries.

methods.name: List[Detection] multi_scale_template_match( image_bgr: np.ndarray, templates_bgr: List[np.ndarray], match_threshold: float = 0.8, scales: Optional[List[float]] = None, method: int = cv2.TM_CCOEFF_NORMED, cfg: Optional[DetectionConfig] = None, page_diag: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Performs multi-scale, multi-rotation template matching on an image using provided templates and configuration, returning detection bounding boxes.

methods.name: List[Detection] feature_match_fallback( image_bgr: np.ndarray, templates_bgr: List[np.ndarray], rotations_deg: Optional[List[float]] = None, min_inliers: int = 8, ransac_reproj_thresh: float = 3.0, cfg: Optional[DetectionConfig] = None, page_diag: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Uses feature detection and RANSAC-based homography estimation to find templates within an image when template matching is insufficient.
